ig_s1_optics_00001_.note: Refused by Ideogram's safety filter. Prompt was written in krea2's plain-text field form; the template warns plain text has a high false-positive rate.

ig2_s1_optics_00001_.note: Refused again with the negative prompt removed — which ruled out my first theory that the negative text tripped the filter.

ig2_s2_cell_00001_.note: Refused again without a negative prompt.

ig2_s4_signal_00001_.note: Refused again without a negative prompt.

j_s2_cell_00001_.note: Refused even as structured JSON, while the other four in the same batch passed — so form was not this one's whole cause.

k_s2_a_plain_00001_.note: The control: plainest possible wording, upright full silhouette. Refused, while the cropped, mounted and lying-down variants of the same subject all passed. The filter judges the rendered image, not only the text.

v2_s2_cell_00001_.note: Rejected: still reads as a bottle. Four attempts failed this way before I found that cfg 1.0 discards the negative prompt and that 'no bottle, no jar' in the positive only injects those words.

v4_s2_cell_00001_.note: Rejected: an open glass tumbler. Piling on more negations made it worse.

v5_s2_cell_00001_.note: Rejected: an open jar with a good tip-off stem. First attempt with every negation deleted.

v6_s2_cell_1_00001_.note: Rejected: sealed at last, but the dome became a bulb.

v6_s2_cell_2_00001_.note: Rejected: the stem sits inside the capsule.

v7_hero_cell_1_00001_.note: Rejected: wide format put the tip-off stem inside the glass.

v7_hero_cell_2_00001_.note: Rejected: same fault, an internal rod instead of an external stem.

v2_s3_machining_00001_.note: Rejected: the block shows a torn fracture face, not a milled one.

v2_w_metrology_00001_.note: Rejected: the dial carries garbled numbers despite the constraint. krea2 cannot write text, so the fix was to remove the dial rather than forbid the numbers.

j_s3_cad_00001_.note: Rejected: asked for exactly six counterbores, got eight — the second time that count came out wrong.

j_s5_pipeline_00001_.note: Rejected: asked for a five-by-five grid, got four-by-four.

k_s2_b_crop_00001_.note: Passed the filter but rejected: beautiful refraction, unreadable as a vapour cell at 210px.

k_s2_d_side_00001_.note: Passed the filter but rejected: the left end reads as open.

m_s2_mount_1_00001_.note: Rejected: letter-like staining on the block's side face.

m_s2_mount_2_00001_.note: Rejected: the glass sits awkwardly over the mount's edge.

x_bench_00001_.note: Complexity test: eight bbox-placed subjects in one scene. Seven held their positions; the oscilloscope trace is a monotonic decay rather than the decaying sinusoid asked for, so it does not depict an FID signal.

x_plate_00001_.note: Text test: four literal strings rendered correctly, spelling and decimal point intact. This is the capability krea2 lacks entirely.

x_spectra_00001_.note: Colour test: global 8-colour palette plus per-element palettes, with highlight and shadow both named as the guide asks.
